csv_project_name: PE & Plan for US 30 Intersection Improvements
csv_agency: State of IN Department of Transportation
csv_scope_of_work: The State of Indiana , Department of Transportation may be seeking a consultant to provide a preliminary engineering and plan development services for US 30 Intersection Improvements , The selected firm shall perform preliminary engineering and plan development services necessary to produce construction contract documents for the listed project(s) in accordance with INDOT's designated letting schedule. The selected firm shall complete an Engineering Assessment/Alternative Analysis for projects where one is not included in the RFP. The selected firm will also be responsible for: Environmental Document, Permit Applications, Topographic Survey, Design and Plan Development, Hydraulic Design, Pavement Design, Utility and Railroad Coordination, Ecological Surveys, Construction Phase Services, and other related services as needed. INDOT will provide Geotechnical Services and Land Acquisition Services for these projects, if needed. Additionally, the selected firm will be responsible for providing professional public outreach and marketing services. These services shall compliment INDOT's efforts to proactively communicate project development updates in an effective manner to various media outlets through the consistent utilization of multi-media messaging and visual illustrations as requested. The selected firm shall coordinate with INDOT on all outreach efforts, which may include stakeholder meetings, information meetings, and/or public hearings as deemed appropriate. In the Letters of Interest (LOIs) for this RFP item, interested respondents shall highlight two (2) Intersection Improvement, Median U-Turns (Des 2600065 & 2600066). Other services such as Wetland Mitigation, Right-of-Way Plan Development (including Right-of-Way Engineering, Title Research, and Staking), Subsurface Utility Exploration (SUE), Archaeological Investigations, and Historical/Architectural Investigation may be included later if these work types become necessary. The INDOT Project Manager and the Consultant will schedule the Scope of Services Meeting within two (2) weeks of the Notice of Selection. The selected firms fee proposal shall be due 45 calendar days after the Scope of Services Meeting for this RFP item
